description: Source file for the DataRegistrationUtility class in the OrangeHRM installer namespace, responsible for managing registration data collection and transmission during installation and upgrade processes.

classes.name: DataRegistrationUtility
classes.description: Provides methods to gather registration data during installation or upgrade, generate unique identifiers, and send registration info to an external service.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Fetches initial registration data from system configuration, including organization info and admin details.

methods.name: getInstallerInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves registration data specific to installer context from session state.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Constructs the registration data payload for transmission, differentiating between installer and upgrader contexts.

methods.name: getSuccessRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Prepares the payload indicating successful registration state.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates and sets a unique instance identifier based on admin and organization details if not already set.

methods.name: sendRegistrationDataOnSuccess
methods.description: Sends registration success data to external service and logs the event.
